python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import os, re
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='src/codegen_support/runtime/io/zlib_filter_flush.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('emitter.call_c("deflate");','emitter.bl_c("deflate");')
# r12/r13 are callee-saved on SysV; use caller-saved scratch instead
s=s.replace('''    emitter.instruction("mov r12d, DWORD PTR [r10 + 32]");                      // reload avail_out left after the sync step
    emitter.instruction(&format!("mov r13d, {FILTER_BUF_SIZE}"));               // the scratch window capacity
    emitter.instruction("sub r13d, r12d");                                      // produced = capacity - avail_out
    emitter.instruction("mov rdi, QWORD PTR [rbp - 8]");                        // fd = the saved file descriptor
    abi::emit_symbol_address(emitter, "rsi", "_stream_filter_buf");
    emitter.instruction("mov edx, r13d");                                       // produced byte count as the write length''',
'''    emitter.instruction("mov r9d, DWORD PTR [r10 + 32]");                       // reload avail_out left after the sync step
    emitter.instruction(&format!("mov r11d, {FILTER_BUF_SIZE}"));               // the scratch window capacity
    emitter.instruction("sub r11d, r9d");                                       // produced = capacity - avail_out
    emitter.instruction("mov rdi, QWORD PTR [rbp - 8]");                        // fd = the saved file descriptor
    abi::emit_symbol_address(emitter, "rsi", "_stream_filter_buf");
    emitter.instruction("mov edx, r11d");                                       // produced byte count as the write length''')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/codegen_support/runtime/io/mod.rs'
s=open(p).read()
m=re.search(r'^mod stream_select_cast_warning;$', s, re.M); assert m
s=s[:m.start()]+'mod zlib_filter_flush;\n'+s[m.start():]
m2=re.search(r'^pub\(crate\) use stream_select_cast_warning::emit_stream_select_cast_warning;$', s, re.M); assert m2
s=s[:m2.start()]+'pub(crate) use zlib_filter_flush::emit_zlib_filter_flush;\n'+s[m2.start():]
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/codegen_support/runtime/emitters/platform.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='    io::emit_stream_select_cast_warning(emitter);'
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old, old+'\n    io::emit_zlib_filter_flush(emitter);')
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('flush helper wired')
PYEOF
